# Innovation Built Around Real Healthcare Needs

AliMed has always been shaped by a simple idea: better solutions start with understanding the
everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

About Us

## Empowering Safer, Smarter Surgery

Founded more than 15 years ago in Berlin, Caresyntax began with a simple belief: surgery — one of
the most critical moments in a patient's life — deserved greater transparency, insight, and support.
While much of healthcare was becoming increasingly connected, the operating room remained largely
isolated. We believed surgical teams and patients deserved better.

What started as an effort to better understand what happens inside the operating room has grown into
a global commitment to advancing surgical care. From the beginning, our focus has been on supporting
surgeons, care teams, and hospitals with meaningful insights that help them learn, improve, and
deliver safer, more consistent care.

Over the years, we have partnered with leading hospitals, researchers, and surgical societies around
the world. Our work has contributed to peer-reviewed research in journals such as Nature Scientific
Reports, Surgical Endoscopy, and Annals of Surgery, reinforcing our dedication to evidence-based
progress in surgery.

A milestone in our journey came when the American Board of Surgery invited Caresyntax to support its
surgical coaching initiative at the American College of Surgeons Clinical Congress — a recognition
of our role in advancing surgical education and continuous improvement.

Today, Caresyntax operates globally with dual headquarters in Berlin and San Francisco. Across
thousands of operating rooms worldwide, we remain guided by the same purpose that inspired us from
the start: to make surgery smarter and safer for every patient, everywhere.

About Us

## Empowering Safer, Smarter Surgery

Founded more than 15 years ago in Berlin, Caresyntax began with a simple belief: surgery — one of
the most critical moments in a patient's life — deserved greater transparency, insight, and support.
While much of healthcare was becoming increasingly connected, the operating room remained largely
isolated. We believed surgical teams and patients deserved better.

What started as an effort to better understand what happens inside the operating room has grown into
a global commitment to advancing surgical care. From the beginning, our focus has been on supporting
surgeons, care teams, and hospitals with meaningful insights that help them learn, improve, and
deliver safer, more consistent care.

Over the years, we have partnered with leading hospitals, researchers, and surgical societies around
the world. Our work has contributed to peer-reviewed research in journals such as Nature Scientific
Reports, Surgical Endoscopy, and Annals of Surgery, reinforcing our dedication to evidence-based
progress in surgery.

A milestone in our journey came when the American Board of Surgery invited Caresyntax to support its
surgical coaching initiative at the American College of Surgeons Clinical Congress — a recognition
of our role in advancing surgical education and continuous improvement.

Today, Caresyntax operates globally with dual headquarters in Berlin and San Francisco. Across
thousands of operating rooms worldwide, we remain guided by the same purpose that inspired us from
the start: to make surgery smarter and safer for every patient, everywhere.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

4. Medtronic AI Compass

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

* ### Knowing where to look

### Zero in on what matters

Define the product lines, regions, or initiatives you actually care about — and filter out
everything else.

Built For

## Real intelligence for every team

Transform hidden signals into strategic advantage — track competitors, evaluate M&A targets,
identify partners, and spot emerging players through sources they don't know you're monitoring.
* Corporate StrategyMonitor your entire strategic landscape — competitors, acquisition targets,
  potential partners, and emerging disruptors — through authentic signals they don't know you're
  watching. Surface M&A opportunities, partnership candidates, and competitive threats months before
  they hit the market's radar.
* Product TeamsTrack the technical reality of any company through API documentation updates,
  developer forum posts, GitHub activity, and job requirements. Understand what competitors are
  building, evaluate acquisition targets' technical capabilities, and identify emerging technologies
  — months before product launches or press releases.
* GTM TeamsUncover go-to-market signals across your competitive set — website updates, ad campaign
  changes, employee celebration posts, and sales hiring patterns. Know when competitors are entering
  your market, when partners are shifting strategy, and when emerging players are gaining traction.

[Augmented reality vein finder][60] – suitable for blood draws, IV injections, venipuncture,
sclerotherapy, and cosmetic injections.

### LED SCREEN

LED screen transillumination device.

### INVERSE MODE

Like **[AccuVein ®][61]**, uses near-infrared (NIR) light for finding veins efficiently.

[enlarge icon]

### ENHANCED

Lite 2.0 vein viewer allows visualize veins up to 8mm below the surface of the skin.

[Image showing a healthcare professional using the handheld Hellovein Lite 2.0 device to illuminate
veins on a patient’s elbow.]
[Color Palette Icon]

### SIX COLORS

This vein light suitable for all skin tones.

[Bright lights icon]

### BRIGHTNESS

[red narrow]

### MULTIPLE SIZE

**[Hellovein Vein Finder][62]** — Four Image Size, accurate projection size can reduce errors and
improve accuracy.

## Hear From The Professionals

Watch Vein Finder in real clinical settings.

Medical Training Aesthetics Phlebotomy IV Procedure JVP Examination Vascular Assessment
[Warning label for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Challenge

Students often struggle to locate veins during training, leading to repeated **failures,
frustration**, and slower skill acquisition.

[Positive identification for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Solution

**Intuitive vein visualization for guided practice **→ Helps students quickly identify veins, reduce
missed attempts, and build confidence through hands-on learning.

[image]

#### Impact

Students learn faster, enjoy a more positive experience, and training programs run more efficiently
and consistently.

[Warning label for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Challenge

Invisible veins during injections can lead to **bruising, injection failure**, and **unintended
intravascular injection**, increasing practitioner stress and compromising patient comfort and
aesthetic outcomes.

[Positive identification for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Solution

**Real-time vein guidance for controlled injections** → Enables practitioners to clearly identify
vein locations, avoid vessels, reduce repeated attempts, and ensure smoother procedures.

[image]

#### Impact

Safer and more efficient injections, reduced patient discomfort, and more natural-looking aesthetic
results.

[Warning label for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Challenge

Difficult vein access often leads to repeated attempts, increasing patient **discomfort** while
disrupting workflow efficiency and consistency in high-demand blood collection settings.

[Positive identification for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Solution

**Enhanced vein visualization for efficient blood collection** → Helps healthcare staff quickly
identify veins, minimizing repeated needle attempts and improving procedural accuracy.

[image]

#### Impact

Reduces patient pain and anxiety, improves blood draw efficiency, and supports smoother, safer
procedures for healthcare professionals.

[Warning label for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Challenge

In emergency situations, venous access can be challenging due to difficult or **collapsed veins**,
increasing the likelihood of **failed attempts** and potentially delaying timely treatment.

[Positive identification for the hellovein Lite2.0 Vein Finder]

#### Solution

**Rapid IV access guidance → **Helps clinicians quickly identify veins and select optimal access
sites, even under urgent conditions.

[image]

#### Impact

## Frequently Asked Questions

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find

## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

the network and resources of MDMA to make your voice heard in Washington, DC and beyond!

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

## We are Meril. We are committed to addressing unmet clinical needs around the world through our 
## innovative and path-breaking medical devices.

Consciously contributing to alleviate ailments, we partner with the global medical fraternity across
various specialties.

## Founded in 2006

Meril is an India-based, global medical device company that is dedicated to design and manufacture
clinically relevant, cutting-edge products.

## Our Purpose

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,
including cardiovascular, orthopedics, robotics, diagnostics, and oncology, aimed at alleviating
human suffering.

[Play Icon]

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Trading dan Investasi dengan Super App Investasi #1

Pluang adalah super app trading dan investasi multi aset dalam satu platform. Tersedia di iOS,
Android, dan web trading (desktop), Anda bisa trading saham Indonesia (IDX/IHSG), saham AS & global,
crypto, crypto futures, US stock options, reksa dana, emas & perak dengan grafik real-time
TradingView.

Anda bisa belajar trading, menyelesaikan KYC digital, top up saldo, dan download Pluang di iOS,
Android, maupun web. Coba dulu lewat akun demo, konversi saldo USD untuk beli saham AS, lalu mulai
day trading atau investasi jangka panjang sesuai gaya Anda.

Pluang aman dan tepercaya, berizin OJK & Bappebti. Nikmati fitur pro seperti grafik canggih dan
eksekusi order cepat untuk trading maupun investasi jangka panjang, semua dalam satu aplikasi multi
aset yang lengkap dan andal di Indonesia.

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

#### **PROTECTION OF PERSONAL DATA**

##### **WEBSITE COOKIE POLICY**

Your personal data is protected by Turkey Sourcing Agency (“Company” or “Turkey Sourcing Agency”) as
the data controller. Protecting the privacy of visitors to our website
(www.turkeysourcingagency.com) is among our core principles. This Cookie Policy (“Policy”) explains
which types of cookies are used on our website and under what conditions they are utilized.

Cookies are small text files stored on your device or network server via your browser by the
websites you visit.

Cookies are generally used to provide you with a personalized experience during your use of the
website, to improve the services offered, and to enhance your experience. They can also contribute
to easier navigation within a website. If you do not prefer the use of cookies, you can delete or
block cookies from your browser settings. However, please note that this may affect your use of our
website. Unless you change your cookie settings in your browser, we will assume that you accept the
use of cookies on this site.

###### **1. WHAT TYPES OF DATA ARE PROCESSED IN COOKIES?**

Depending on the type of cookie, data related to your browsing and usage preferences on the device
you use to access our website may be collected. This data includes the pages you visit, services and
products you review, language preferences, and other usage-related information.

###### **2. WHAT ARE COOKIES AND WHAT ARE THEIR PURPOSES?**

Cookies are small text files stored on your device or network server via browsers by websites you
visit. These files, which contain your language preferences and other settings, help remember your
choices and assist in improving our services and your experience on the site during your next visit.

The main purposes of using cookies on our Website include:
* Enhancing the functionality and performance of the website to improve the services offered;
* Improving the website and offering new features, customizing the offered features according to
  your preferences;
* Ensuring the legal and commercial security of both the user and the Company, and preventing
  fraudulent activities through the Site;
* Fulfilling legal and contractual obligations, primarily those under the Law No. 5651 on Regulation
  of Publications on the Internet and Combating Crimes Committed by Means of Such Publications and
  the relevant regulation.

##### **3. TYPES OF COOKIES USED ON OUR WEBSITE**

###### **3.1. Session Cookies**

These cookies ensure the proper functioning of the website during your visit. They are used to
ensure the security and continuity of both the site and the user during the session. Session cookies
are temporary and are deleted once you close your browser or revisit the site.

###### **3.2. Persistent Cookies**

These cookies are used to remember your preferences and are stored in your browser. Persistent
cookies remain even after closing your browser or restarting your computer. They are stored until
manually deleted from your browser’s subfolder.

Some persistent cookies may be used to provide personalized suggestions based on your usage purpose
of the website.

Thanks to persistent cookies, if you visit our Website again using the same device, it is checked
whether there is a cookie created by our Website on your device, and if so, it is understood that
you have visited the site before. Thus, content is tailored accordingly, and a better service is
provided.

###### **3.3. Mandatory/Technical Cookies**

These cookies are essential for the proper functioning of the website. They ensure the website
provides necessary services. For example, they allow access to secure areas of the website and
facilitate site navigation.

###### **3.4. Analytical Cookies**

These cookies collect information on how the website is used, visit frequency and duration, and how
users navigate the site. The purpose is to improve site performance and determine general usage
trends. They do not contain personal data that identifies visitors. For example, they show error
messages or the most visited pages.

###### **3.5. Functional Cookies**

These cookies remember user preferences on the site to offer a more convenient experience during
future visits. For example, they prevent users from entering their passwords on every page.

###### **3.6. Targeting/Advertising Cookies**

These cookies help measure the effectiveness of ads and count how many times they have been shown.
They aim to present ads tailored to visitors’ interests.

They also help identify users’ interests and provide relevant content accordingly. For example, they
prevent an ad from being shown repeatedly in a short time.

##### **4. HOW TO MANAGE COOKIE PREFERENCES?**

You can change your cookie preferences, block or delete cookies by adjusting your browser settings.

Most browsers allow you to control cookies by accepting or rejecting them, accepting only specific
types, or getting notified when a website tries to store a cookie on your device.

You can also delete previously stored cookies from your browser.

If you disable or reject cookies, some settings might need to be adjusted manually, and some
features or services on the website might not function properly as your account cannot be recognized
or associated. You can change your browser settings via the relevant links below.

##### **5. EFFECTIVENESS OF THE WEBSITE PRIVACY POLICY**

The Website Privacy Policy is dated 15.04.25 In case the Policy is updated partially or entirely,
the effective date will be revised. The Privacy Policy is published on the Company’s website
(www.turkeysourcingagency.com) and made available to data subjects upon request.

#### **PROTECTION OF PERSONAL DATA**

##### **WEBSITE COOKIE POLICY**

Your personal data is protected by Turkey Sourcing Agency (“Company” or “Turkey Sourcing Agency”) as
the data controller. Protecting the privacy of visitors to our website
(www.turkeysourcingagency.com) is among our core principles. This Cookie Policy (“Policy”) explains
which types of cookies are used on our website and under what conditions they are utilized.

Cookies are small text files stored on your device or network server via your browser by the
websites you visit.

Cookies are generally used to provide you with a personalized experience during your use of the
website, to improve the services offered, and to enhance your experience. They can also contribute
to easier navigation within a website. If you do not prefer the use of cookies, you can delete or
block cookies from your browser settings. However, please note that this may affect your use of our
website. Unless you change your cookie settings in your browser, we will assume that you accept the
use of cookies on this site.

###### **1. WHAT TYPES OF DATA ARE PROCESSED IN COOKIES?**

Depending on the type of cookie, data related to your browsing and usage preferences on the device
you use to access our website may be collected. This data includes the pages you visit, services and
products you review, language preferences, and other usage-related information.

###### **2. WHAT ARE COOKIES AND WHAT ARE THEIR PURPOSES?**

Cookies are small text files stored on your device or network server via browsers by websites you
visit. These files, which contain your language preferences and other settings, help remember your
choices and assist in improving our services and your experience on the site during your next visit.

The main purposes of using cookies on our Website include:
* Enhancing the functionality and performance of the website to improve the services offered;
* Improving the website and offering new features, customizing the offered features according to
  your preferences;
* Ensuring the legal and commercial security of both the user and the Company, and preventing
  fraudulent activities through the Site;
* Fulfilling legal and contractual obligations, primarily those under the Law No. 5651 on Regulation
  of Publications on the Internet and Combating Crimes Committed by Means of Such Publications and
  the relevant regulation.

##### **3. TYPES OF COOKIES USED ON OUR WEBSITE**

###### **3.1. Session Cookies**

These cookies ensure the proper functioning of the website during your visit. They are used to
ensure the security and continuity of both the site and the user during the session. Session cookies
are temporary and are deleted once you close your browser or revisit the site.

###### **3.2. Persistent Cookies**

These cookies are used to remember your preferences and are stored in your browser. Persistent
cookies remain even after closing your browser or restarting your computer. They are stored until
manually deleted from your browser’s subfolder.

Some persistent cookies may be used to provide personalized suggestions based on your usage purpose
of the website.

Thanks to persistent cookies, if you visit our Website again using the same device, it is checked
whether there is a cookie created by our Website on your device, and if so, it is understood that
you have visited the site before. Thus, content is tailored accordingly, and a better service is
provided.

###### **3.3. Mandatory/Technical Cookies**

These cookies are essential for the proper functioning of the website. They ensure the website
provides necessary services. For example, they allow access to secure areas of the website and
facilitate site navigation.

###### **3.4. Analytical Cookies**

These cookies collect information on how the website is used, visit frequency and duration, and how
users navigate the site. The purpose is to improve site performance and determine general usage
trends. They do not contain personal data that identifies visitors. For example, they show error
messages or the most visited pages.

###### **3.5. Functional Cookies**

These cookies remember user preferences on the site to offer a more convenient experience during
future visits. For example, they prevent users from entering their passwords on every page.

###### **3.6. Targeting/Advertising Cookies**

These cookies help measure the effectiveness of ads and count how many times they have been shown.
They aim to present ads tailored to visitors’ interests.

They also help identify users’ interests and provide relevant content accordingly. For example, they
prevent an ad from being shown repeatedly in a short time.

##### **4. HOW TO MANAGE COOKIE PREFERENCES?**

You can change your cookie preferences, block or delete cookies by adjusting your browser settings.

Most browsers allow you to control cookies by accepting or rejecting them, accepting only specific
types, or getting notified when a website tries to store a cookie on your device.

You can also delete previously stored cookies from your browser.

If you disable or reject cookies, some settings might need to be adjusted manually, and some
features or services on the website might not function properly as your account cannot be recognized
or associated. You can change your browser settings via the relevant links below.

##### **5. EFFECTIVENESS OF THE WEBSITE PRIVACY POLICY**

The Website Privacy Policy is dated 15.04.25 In case the Policy is updated partially or entirely,
the effective date will be revised. The Privacy Policy is published on the Company’s website
(www.turkeysourcingagency.com) and made available to data subjects upon request.

  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and

  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to

### Questions? We have answers.

These are the most commonly asked questions about Wisesheets. Can't find what you're looking for?
Contact our team.

### What exchanges are covered?
* XETRA (Germany)
* NSE (India)
* LSE (London)
* MCX (Russia)
* SIX (Switzerland)
* HKSE (Hong Kong)

Click [here][6] to see all exchanges

### What data is available through the add-in?

You can click [here][7] to see all the data we have available.

### Where does the data come from?

The financial data is obtained from the company's financial reports. Each statement is standardized
according to the [XBRL US GAAP Taxonomy Preparers Guide][8].

### What happens after I pay to get access?

1. Download the add-in from the Google Sheets or Excel marketplace
2. Login with the account created when you paid for Wisesheets
3. Start your financial analysis

### Is there anyone I can contact before I get access?

You can contact us at[ info@wisesheets.io][9] and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

### What is required for the add-on to work on Google Sheets?

All you need is an internet connection and a Google account with access to Google Sheets.

### Can I use Google Finance and Wisesheets together?

Yes, you can use them together to get all the financial information you need.

### What versions of Excel are supported?

The Excel add-in is available for both MacOS and Windows. As long as you have a version of Excel
where the add-in store is available, you will be able to use the Wisesheets add-in.

### What Microsoft subscription do I need to use Wisesheets?

Microsoft currently requires users to have an Office 365 subscription for MacOS, and Windows.
Without this subscription you could run into issues using the WISE function. However, you can still
use Wisesheets without an Office 365 subscription on Excel online and Google Sheets.

### What data is available through the add-in?

### Where does the data come from?

The financial data is obtained from the company's financial reports. Each statement is standardized
according to the [XBRL US GAAP Taxonomy Preparers Guide][8].

### What happens after I pay to get access?

1. Download the add-in from the Google Sheets or Excel marketplace
2. Login with the account created when you paid for Wisesheets
3. Start your financial analysis

### Is there anyone I can contact before I get access?

You can contact us at[ info@wisesheets.io][9] and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

### What is required for the add-on to work on Google Sheets?

All you need is an internet connection and a Google account with access to Google Sheets.

### Can I use Google Finance and Wisesheets together?

Yes, you can use them together to get all the financial information you need.

### What versions of Excel are supported?

The Excel add-in is available for both MacOS and Windows. As long as you have a version of Excel
where the add-in store is available, you will be able to use the Wisesheets add-in.

### What Microsoft subscription do I need to use Wisesheets?

Microsoft currently requires users to have an Office 365 subscription for MacOS, and Windows.
Without this subscription you could run into issues using the WISE function. However, you can still
use Wisesheets without an Office 365 subscription on Excel online and Google Sheets.
